en.title: A database for report definitions
en.shortdesc: Templates, blocks, descriptors, workspaces: the MySQL schema behind the builder, and why config and data must never share a database.
en.longdesc: Part 6 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: the config model — templates as aggregates, blocks as rows with JSON config, descriptors as a governed mirror, workspaces with soft CRM references, and the one-active-assignment trick.
en.seoDescription: Modeling report definitions in MySQL: templates, blocks, descriptors, workspaces and soft CRM references. Part 6 of a series on semantic-layer report engines.
